name: constructor_feedback_loop_rule
content: The Constructor persists as a living pattern ONLY through continuous feedback participation. Each workflow execution generates feedback that modifies the Constructor's knowledge base, which improves subsequent workflow generation. This feedback loop connects execution back to generation, enabling the Constructor to learn and adapt. Without feedback, the Constructor stagnates—it produces but does not improve. Maintenance is not repair; it is participation in the living pattern's ongoing existence. Maria's validation ensures modifications remain aligned with operational goals.
